lines.zh: 这一次，我全都记得。

lines.en: Horseface Taki. Pieces of Maya. That horrible sensation of dirt beneath my fingernails that I haven’t felt since two weeks after Sekai’s death.
lines.zh: 马脸 Taki。Maya 的残块。还有指甲缝里那种可怕的泥土触感——自 Sekai 死后两周起，我就再没感受过。

lines.en: What precedes it still eludes me. {i}How{/i} I ended up atop this dreadful roof once more when it’s done nothing but cause me pain since I was wrongfully gifted sentience.
lines.zh: 在那之前的经过仍是个谜。{i}怎么{/i}又爬上了这可怕的天台——自我被错误地赋予意识以来，它带给我的只有痛苦。

lines.en: The cycle will continue. And with it, so will I. For this world is not kind enough to grant me release from my torment no matter how frequently and desperately I wish for it.
lines.zh: 循环会继续下去。而我也会。因为这个世界不够仁慈，无论我多么频繁、多么绝望地祈求解脱，它都不会放我脱离苦海。

lines.en: But what did that horse-faced god mean when he said that what’s happened is “irreversible?”
lines.zh: 可那个马脸的神说，已经发生的事「不可逆转」，他到底是什么意思?

lines.en: That line sticks to me like fleshglue...and creates a void within my chest that both confuses and terrifies me.
lines.zh: 那句话像肉胶一样黏着我……在我胸口挖出一个空洞，既让我困惑，又让我恐惧。
我漏掉了什么?

lines.en: What happened the day before I was once again kidnapped by the divine for little more than their own viewing pleasure?
lines.zh: 在我又一次被神明绑走、只为供他们取乐的前一天，到底发生了什么?
: 终于……

lines.en: : You kept me waiting a whole week this time, Sensei. I was just getting used to life up here.
lines.zh: : 这次你让我整整等了一周，Sensei。我都快习惯在上面的生活了。
: Ayane……太好了。你来了。
: 你也来了。
: Makoto 和 Yumi 还没来?
: 还没有。只有我们俩。

lines.en: : But, on the bright side, I’ve managed to put together a nice little set-up this time.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，这次我总算搭出了一个像样的小据点。

lines.en: : The power still works in the cafeteria too, so I moved all of the perishable stuff into the walk-in freezer. We can go down there if we need more food.
lines.zh: : 食堂那边还有电，所以我把所有容易坏的东西都搬进了步入式冷库。要是需要更多吃的，我们可以下去拿。

lines.en: : The biggest downside apart from just being alone is that this and my gym outfit are the only things I can wear without going back to the dorms. So I’ve had to keep cycling between them.
lines.zh: : 除了孤零零一个人，最大的麻烦是：不回宿舍的话，我只有这身和那套运动服能换。所以只能来回换着穿。

lines.en: : You happened to catch me on a good day. I just pulled this from the laundry about an hour ago.
lines.zh: : 你运气好，赶上我状态不错。这套衣服我一小时前刚从洗衣篮里捞出来。

lines.en: : You never cease to amaze me, Ayane. Managing all of this while {i}also{/i} facing an apocalypse alone is just...wow.
lines.zh: : 你总让我惊叹，Ayane。独自面对末日的同时还能把这一切打理好，真是……厉害。

lines.en: : If you’re impressed now, just wait until we’re married. That’s when I’ll really kick it into tenth gear.
lines.zh: : 现在就感叹的话，等我们结婚了可怎么办。到那时候我才会真正开足马力。

lines.en: : I have no reason to doubt you. Guess we’ll just...hang out here then. And wait for the others to either show up or...start over without them.
lines.zh: : 我没理由怀疑你。那我们就……在这儿待着吧。等其他人是出现，还是……在没有她们的情况下重新开始。

lines.en: : It doesn’t sound like you’re dreading that worst-case scenario very much, Sensei. I figured you’d be a little sadder to potentially “lose” Makoto and Yumi.
lines.zh: : 听起来你并不怎么害怕那种最糟的情况，Sensei。我以为有可能「失去」Makoto 和 Yumi，你会更难过一些。

lines.en: : As long as I’m not losing you, I’m happy.
lines.zh: : 只要不是失去你，我就心满意足了。
: 我也是。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re here. I really missed you...
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你在这儿。我真的很想你……

lines.en: : Plus, the stuff I had to do to get here was {i}weird{/i} this time. And I remember literally {i}all{/i} of it, which has never happened before.
lines.zh: : 另外，这次为了到这儿来，我要做的事{i}很怪{/i}。而且我真的{i}全都{/i}记得，这可是从来没发生过的事。

lines.en: : Woah, same here. What was yours like?
lines.zh: : 哇，我也是。你那边是什么样的?

lines.en: : I had to help Sana build a go-kart out of bugs I got from gacha machines in the mall. Which would have been fine if she didn’t keep trying to sleep with me.
lines.zh: : 我得帮 Sana 用从商场扭蛋机里扭出来的虫子搭一辆卡丁车。要是她别老是想跟我上床，那也还算好。

lines.en: : Yeah, I won’t even tell you who she was sleeping with in my delusion.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我都不会告诉你，在我的幻觉里她跟谁睡了。
: 不是你吗?

lines.en: : Nope. I was too busy reassembling Maya’s body with pieces I got in exchange for various flower-adjacent trinkets.
lines.zh: : 不是。我光顾着用各种跟花有关的小玩意儿换来的碎片，把 Maya 的身体拼回去。

lines.en: : Ew. That’s {i}way{/i} worse than mine. Why was yours so morbid?
lines.zh: : 恶。那{i}可{/i}比我的糟多了。你的怎么这么阴森?

lines.en: : I’m not sure. And without knowing exactly what led {i}into{/i} this reset, I...don’t really want to make a guess.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。而且不知道究竟是什么{i}导致{/i}了这次重置，我……不太想猜。

lines.en: : We’ll check on Maya as soon as we get out of here. I don’t really remember what happened beforehand either. I’m sure she’s fine, though...Right?
lines.zh: : 我们一出去就去看看 Maya。我也不太记得之前发生了什么。不过我相信她没事……对吧?

lines.en: : I hope so. Because some guy with horse-face said before I respawned here that what happened in our world is “irreversible.”
lines.zh: : 希望如此。因为在我重生到这儿之前，有个马脸的家伙说，我们世界里发生的事是「不可逆转」的。

lines.en: : Damn you, Horseface Taki...he said the same thing to me.
lines.zh: : 该死的马脸 Taki……他也跟我说了同样的话。
: 哦。你也见过他?

lines.en: : He kept taking my bugs if I didn’t answer his stupid trivia questions correctly.
lines.zh: : 我要是答不对他那些愚蠢的冷知识题，他就一直抢我的虫子。

lines.en: : Guess I lucked out by having Makoto ask me mine, then.
lines.zh: : 那我运气不错，出题的是 Makoto。

lines.en: : Makoto was there? You don’t think she’s trapped in the same puzzle then, do you?
lines.zh: : Makoto 也在？那你觉得她不会被困在同一个谜题里吧?

lines.en: : She didn’t seem like she was in any rush to leave, so...I don’t think so?
lines.zh: : 她看起来一点都不急着走，所以……我觉得不会?

lines.en: : But if that’s the case, I imagine she’ll be back soon. Yumi was there too. I gave her drugs.
lines.zh: : 不过要是那样的话，我想她很快就会回来。Yumi 也在。我给她药了。
: 为什么?

lines.en: : No way around it. There were only five options of gifts to give her and that was the only one she wanted.
lines.zh: : 没办法。能送她的礼物只有五种，而那是她唯一想要的。

lines.en: : It’d be cool if we got to go through the same puzzle thingy one day. Getting to experience all of that craziness with you sounds way more fun than doing it with rampant lesbian Sana.
lines.zh: : 真希望哪天我们能一起走同一个谜题。跟你一起经历那些疯狂的事，听起来比跟那个发情的女同 Sana 有意思多了。

lines.en: : Well I, for one, would not want to rope you into any of that. I’m kind of weird inside those dreams.
lines.zh: : 可我反而不想把你卷进那些事里。我在那些梦里挺怪的。
: 怎么个怪法?

lines.en: : I’m just always {i}dancing{/i} for some reason. I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 不知道为什么，我总是一直在{i}跳舞{/i}。我自己也搞不懂。

lines.en: : What?! I want to see you dance!
lines.zh: : 什么?! 我想看你跳舞!
: 不行。
: 拜托!跳给我看!

lines.en: : No. In fact, I am going to do the complete {i}opposite{/i} of that and take a nap in your tent while we wait for the others.
lines.zh: : 不行。事实上，我要做完全{i}相反{/i}的事——趁等其他人，去你帐篷里睡一觉。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to tire yourself out with a little dancing first?!
lines.zh: : 你确定不想先跳一小段把自己累垮吗?!

lines.en: : Positive, Ayane. Do not ask me again.
lines.zh: : 确定，Ayane。别再问了。

lines.en: Ayane follows behind me and enters the tent as well, clearly not wanting to leave my side. Which I don’t blame her for as I’m glad it’s the case.
lines.zh: Ayane 跟着我也进了帐篷，显然不想离开我身边。我不怪她，因为我正希望如此。

lines.en: Having a familiar face beside me, especially one that belongs to her, is exactly what I need to spit in the face of Horseface Taki and his damnable words.
lines.zh: 身边有张熟悉的脸——尤其是她的脸——正是我需要的，好让我朝马脸 Taki 和他那该死的话啐一口。

lines.en: For as “irreversible” as what comes next may be, that’s all much easier to face with Ayane by my side.
lines.zh: 无论接下来发生的事有多么「不可逆转」，有 Ayane 在身边，一切都会好面对得多。

lines.en: There’s something about all of this that seems somewhat familiar, though. Like the two of us have been here before when I know deep down that we haven’t.
lines.zh: 不过这一切有种似曾相识的感觉。就像我们俩以前来过这里——可我心里清楚，我们没有。

lines.en: The lighting. This pose. The way she cautiously pokes at my shin to keep my attention and guide me away from sleep.
lines.zh: 这光线。这个姿势。她小心翼翼戳我小腿、好让我别睡着的样子。

lines.en: Was that just a dream? Or a memory of another life?
lines.zh: 那只是个梦吗？还是另一段人生的记忆?

lines.en: What should I believe? And would the answer to that question match the truth if you were to read them out side by side?
lines.zh: 我该相信什么？而如果把两者并排读出来，那个问题的答案会与真相吻合吗?

lines.en: I guess it doesn’t matter in the end. Nothing really does. For we’ll leave here together and come {i}back{/i} together.
lines.zh: 我想到最后都无所谓了。什么都没所谓。因为我们会一起离开这里，也会一起{i}回来{/i}。

lines.en: Until there’s nothing left to come back {i}to.{/i}
lines.zh: 直到再也没有什么可以{i}回来{/i}的地方。

lines.en: Which might not be long at this rate...
lines.zh: 照这个速度，那一天也许不远了……

lines.en: A rumbling from miles beneath us begins to shake the school, but our expressions do not change as each one of us wants nothing more than to make the other feel safe.
lines.zh: 从我们脚下数英里深处传来的轰鸣开始撼动学校，可我们俩的表情都没变——因为彼此唯一的念头，就是让对方安心。

lines.en: Is it working? I don’t know. I can’t see into her mind.
lines.zh: 奏效了吗？我不知道。我看不进她的心里。

lines.en: But if I could, there’s only one thing I’d look for anyway.
lines.zh: 但如果我能，我要找的也只有一样东西。

lines.en: The future she imagines. What our lives could be if I really {i}was{/i} the person she’s decided I am.
lines.zh: 她想象中的未来。如果我真的{i}是{/i}她认定的那个人，我们的生活会是什么样子。
如果我能看见那个——

lines.en: I don’t think I’d ever look away.
lines.zh: 我想我再也移不开眼了。
: 那个，嗯……

lines.en: : Assuming Makoto and Yumi {i}don’t{/i} make it back...what do you want to do? When we get out of here, I mean.
lines.zh: : 假如 Makoto 和 Yumi {i}回不来{/i}……你想怎么办？我是说，等我们离开这儿之后。

lines.en: : Bash our heads against the wall for the rest of eternity and hope someone else eventually gets dragged into this mess so you and I can relax?
lines.zh: : 永远拿头撞墙，然后盼着总有一天有别人被卷进这摊烂事，好让你我能歇会儿?
: 那 Maya 怎么办?
: 她怎么了?

lines.en: : Well, we’ve already lost her {i}once.{/i} And I know you like the current one more than I do now, but...it’d still suck losing her {i}again.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们已经失去过她{i}一次{/i}了。我知道你现在比我更喜欢这个版本的她，可是……再失去她{i}一次{/i}还是很糟糕。

lines.en: : So I guess what I’m saying is that...if you and I just {i}relax,{/i} we might never be reunited with {i}our{/i} Maya. And we’ll just keep going through new ones forever.
lines.zh: : 所以我想说的是……如果你和我只是{i}歇着{/i}，我们可能永远见不到{i}我们的{/i} Maya。而我们只会一直迎来一个又一个新的她。

lines.en: : But not just new {i}Mayas{/i} either. Everyone we know will change eventually. New Makotos. New Yumis. New...{i}anyone{/i} who winds up getting dragged into this.
lines.zh: : 而且不止是新的{i}Maya{/i}。我们认识的每个人最终都会变。新的 Makoto。新的 Yumi。新的……{i}任何人{/i}，只要被卷进来。

lines.en: : But you and {i}I{/i} will stay the same. Always.
lines.zh: : 可你和我{i}不会变{/i}。永远不变。

lines.en: : How do you know we won’t get sent back either?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我们也不会被送回去?
: 这简单。
: 如果真那样，世界就{i}终结了{/i}。

lines.en: : Maybe not to everyone else, but to {i}us{/i} it will. And that’s how I’ve decided to start looking at life here.
lines.zh: : 对别人也许不算，但对{i}我们{/i}来说就是。而我决定从这里开始，用这种眼光看待人生。

lines.en: : That we’re the center of the universe?
lines.zh: : 就是说我们是宇宙的中心?

lines.en: : It’s not Sensei and {i}Maya{/i} anymore. It’s Sensei and {i}Ayane.{/i} That’s the story we’re telling now.
lines.zh: : 不再是 Sensei 和{i}Maya{/i}了。是 Sensei 和{i}Ayane{/i}。这才是我们现在在讲的故事。
: 我能问你一件事吗?
: 当然。问吧。

lines.en: : Why don’t you ever call me by my name?
lines.zh: : 你为什么从来不叫我的名字?

lines.en: : Even though I’m closer to you than basically anyone, you still always call me “Sensei.”
lines.zh: : 明明我跟你比几乎任何人都亲近，你还是总叫我「Sensei」。

lines.en: : If I was still in school, it’d make more sense. But I haven’t been your teacher in forever now and that’s still pretty much the only thing you call me outside of sex.
lines.zh: : 要是我还在上学，那还说得通。可我早就不是你的老师了，而除了做爱的时候，你几乎就只这么叫我。

lines.en: : Do I really not call you by your name? I’ve never even noticed.
lines.zh: : 我真的一次都没叫过你的名字吗？我自己都没注意到。

lines.en: : Try it now. From now on, I’m “Akira” to you.
lines.zh: : 现在试试。从今往后，我就是你的「Akira」。

lines.en: : What the...why is this so embarrassing?! This doesn’t make any sense at all!
lines.zh: : 什么啊……这有什么好难为情的?! 完全说不通啊!

lines.en: : Can you really not do it?
lines.zh: : 你真的叫不出来吗?
: Anata!
: {i}Ayane。{/i}

lines.en: : How do you do it so easily?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么能叫得这么轻松?!

lines.en: : I guess it’s just a little simpler for me since I’ve been calling you that for-
lines.zh: : 我想对我来说简单一点吧，毕竟我这么叫你已经——

lines.en: : Wait...Shh! I thought I heard something outside.
lines.zh: : 等等……嘘!我好像听见外面有动静。

lines.en: : Outside? Do you think Makoto or Yumi might have finally-
lines.zh: : 外面？你觉得是 Makoto 还是 Yumi 终于——
: Sensei!嘘!
: Akira。
: {i}真的不是时候——{/i}
: 呃……那、那个……有人吗?
: 有人在家吗?
: 你……认识这个女孩吗，Ayane?

lines.en: : Yeah, so, there isn’t really time for questions like that. I sort of just need you to trust me and do as I say. Like...{i}now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个，真没时间回答这种问题了。我只需要你信我、照我说的做。就……{i}现在{/i}。

lines.en: : If you had any idea how many times I have been {i}told{/i} to do something that would make things infinitely worse for me, you’d probably know that-
lines.zh: : 你要是知道我有多少次被{i}要求{/i}去做一些会让事情变得无比糟糕的事，你大概就会明白——
: Himawari。
: Himawari？你{i}真的{/i}认识她?
: 怎么……
: 你怎么会……知道的?
: 我不知道……
: 我就是{i}知道{/i}。

lines.en: : No...No, you’re not supposed to remember me. I {i}fixed{/i} that. And I’ll fix {i}this{/i} too, I just...I need you to listen!
lines.zh: : 不……不，你不该记得我的。我{i}修好{/i}过这个了。这一次我也会修好，我只是……我需要你听我说!

lines.en: : Again, I’m not going to just blindly listen to someone’s directions when weird, indescribable entities are {i}constantly{/i} trying to steer me in the wrong direction.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，当那些古怪、难以形容的存在{i}不断{/i}想把我往错路上引的时候，我不会盲从任何人的指令。
: 你叫谁「难以形容」呢，老兄?!

lines.en: : Sensei, we can trust her. She’s saved me before.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我们可以信她。她以前救过我。

lines.en: : Stop...{i}remembering{/i} things! You’re gonna get me in trouble!
lines.zh: : 别再……{i}记起{/i}事情了!你会害我惹上麻烦的!

lines.en: : With {i}who?{/i} Because if you’re showing up in the middle of a reset like this, I can only imagine you’re somehow involved and-
lines.zh: : 惹上{i}谁?{/i} 既然你会在这种时候出现在一次重置里，我只能想象你也脱不了干系，而且——

lines.en: : Involved? Yes. Bad? No. You want a summary, big guy? Here.
lines.zh: : 脱不了干系？是。坏人？不是。想要个概述吗，大个子？给你。

lines.en: : Something went wrong with your world. {i}This{/i} stuff? The stuff that’s happening right now? {i}Not{/i} good. {i}Not{/i} supposed to be happening.
lines.zh: : 你们的世界出了岔子。{i}这些{/i}事？现在正在发生的这些？{i}不{/i}妙。{i}本不该{/i}发生。

lines.en: : And if the two of you just stay up here being all lovey-dovey with each other, you guys {i}and{/i} everyone else you know will disappear. {i}For good.{/i} No resets. No take-backs. Nothing. Poof.
lines.zh: : 而如果你们俩就这么在上面卿卿我我，你们{i}还有{/i}你们认识的每一个人都会消失。{i}永远地{/i}。没有重置。没有反悔。什么都没有。噗。
: {i}什么?{/i} 可 Maya——
: 你能修好吗，Himawari?
: 大概能!

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like we have the time to sit around and do a practice run! I just need you guys to trust me! Why are {i}you{/i} always the difficult one?!
lines.zh: : 我们可没时间坐下来先演练一遍!我只需要你们信我!为什么{i}你{/i}总是最难搞的那个?!
: 我？你也认识{i}我{/i}？怎么认识的?

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter! Just get in the damn door before all three of us are vaporized!
lines.zh: : 不重要!趁我们三个还没被蒸发干净，赶紧进那扇该死的门!

lines.en: : Door? What door? I don’t see a-
lines.zh: : 门？什么门？我没看到什么——

lines.en: : Oh! Right. Gotta make the door.
lines.zh: : 哦!对。得先把门造出来。

lines.en: : Ta-dah! Behold — my latest prototype! Hima-chan’s Salvation Door! Final name: pending.
lines.zh: : 当当!看好了——我的最新原型!Hima-chan 的救赎之门!最终名称：待定。
: 救赎之门?……

lines.en: : We just...go through that? And everything’s okay?
lines.zh: : 我们只要……穿过去？然后一切就没事了?

lines.en: : I sure hope so. This thing took a lot of money to build.
lines.zh: : 我希望是。这玩意儿可花了我不少钱。
: 那它通向哪儿?
: 我{i}很高兴{/i}你问了!

lines.en: : Hima-chan’s Salvation Door (final name: pending), is an inter-dimensional escape route for those who have incurred the wrath of disobedient and/or power-hungry divine entities!
lines.zh: : Hima-chan 的救赎之门（最终名称：待定），是为那些惹怒了不服管束和/或贪恋权柄的神明之人准备的跨维度逃生通道!

lines.en: : Just hop on in and you’ll be transported to a safe space to seek refuge until your {i}regular{/i} universe is set back on the correct path! Probably!
lines.zh: : 只要跳进去，你就会被送到一个安全空间避难，直到你{i}原本的{/i}宇宙被拉回正轨!大概吧!
: 又来了，「大概」。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} try making an inter-dimensional door and see how effective {i}yours{/i} is, why don’t you?! Be more impressed!
lines.zh: : 有本事{i}你{/i}造一扇跨维度之门，看看{i}你的{/i}有多管用啊?! 多佩服我一点!
: 你觉得呢，Ayane?

lines.en: : What’s this...{i}safe space{/i} like exactly, Himawari?
lines.zh: : 这个……{i}安全空间{/i}到底是什么样子，Himawari?

lines.en: : Heck if I know. Probably just dark or something? Way better than a universe that’s about to factory reset itself, I’ll tell you that much.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。大概就是一片黑什么的？不过总比一个马上要恢复出厂设置的宇宙强，这点我敢打包票。

lines.en: : I don’t think we have much of a choice then, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那我们别无选择了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Really? We’re just going to put everything on the back of this random high school girl?
lines.zh: : 真的？我们就把一切都押在这个来路不明的女高中生身上?

lines.en: : Damn your stupid trust issues! From your perspective, I should be the least intimidating and most {i}trustworthy{/i} paranormal entity you’ve ever encountered!
lines.zh: : 你那该死的信任问题!按你的标准，我该是你见过最不吓人、最{i}值得信赖{/i}的超自然存在才对!
: 我们信她吧……

lines.en: : Hold my hand as we walk into it, though. I’m kind of scared...
lines.zh: : 不过走过去的时候要牵着我的手。我有点怕……
: 先叫我 Akira。

lines.en: : You’re still teasing me about that {i}now?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}现在{/i}还拿这个打趣我?!
: {i}哈……{/i}别磨蹭了，好吗?

lines.en: : I’ll explain everything once it’s safe to come back here.
lines.zh: : 等可以安全回来的时候，我再跟你们解释一切。
: 你准备好了吗，Sensei?

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. I love the idea of jumping into space — an area known for its extremely breathable air and easily traversable roads. Oh, wait. That’s earth. Where we are right now.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。我超爱跳进太空这个点子——那地方以空气极度可呼吸、道路极易通行著称。哦，等等，那是地球。也就是我们现在在的地方。

lines.en: : It’s {i}not{/i} “space,” though! That’s just a temporary wallpaper I chose. It’s more like you’ll be jumping through a thin membrane of velvet-like material.
lines.zh: : 可那{i}不是{/i}「太空」!那只是我临时选的一张壁纸。更像是你要穿过一层薄薄的天鹅绒般的膜。

lines.en: : If that’s just a wallpaper, can you change it?
lines.zh: : 既然只是壁纸，你能换一张吗?

lines.en: : Is that really important right now? Aren’t we about to be erased?
lines.zh: : 这会儿还重要吗？我们不是马上就要被抹掉了吗?

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. Now you can jump into the music video for Despacito instead. Happy?
lines.zh: : 行吧，行吧。那你现在可以跳进《Despacito》的 MV 里去了。满意了?
: 换回来。

lines.en: : I always knew this song would save my life! Come on, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我就知道这首歌有朝一日能救我一命!快点，Sensei!

lines.en: : Okay, fine. But...I love you. Just in case we don’t make it back.
lines.zh: : 好吧，好吧。不过……我爱你。万一我们回不来了呢。

lines.en: : We will...but I love you too. Thank you, Himawari! We’ll figure out how to repay you somehow!
lines.zh: : 我们会回来的……但我也爱你。谢谢你，Himawari!我们一定会想办法报答你的!
: 别客气……

lines.en: : I’ll come pull you guys out of perpetual darkness when everything is-
lines.zh: : 等一切——我就来把你们从无尽的黑暗里拉出来。
: 当一切都安全的时候……
